title: Sacrilegious
summary: SACRILE'GIOUS, adjective [Latin sacrilegus.] 1. Violating sacred things; polluted with the crime of sacrilege. Above the reach of sacrilegious hands. 2. Containing sacrilege; as a sacrilegious attempt

inlines.v: SACRILE'GIOUS, adjective [Latin sacrilegus.] 1. Violating sacred things; polluted with the crime of sacrilege. Above the reach of sacrilegious hands. 2. Containing sacrilege; as a sacrilegious attempt or act.
